summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing the timing of its third-quarter 2026 results and related conference call. Results will be released after market close on November 4, 2026, with a call and webcast on November 5, 2026 at 9 a.m. Alberta Time (10 a.m. Eastern). No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved. This is a routine scheduling announcement for a foreign private issuer, mapped to a US Form 8-K equivalent, and offers no risk-arb angle.
